{{About|the computer algorithm|other uses|Pegasus (disambiguation)}}

'''PEGASUS''' is an [[encryption]] [[algorithm]] used for [[satellite]] [[telemetry]], command link and mission [[data transfer]]s.

According to a budget item justification document for FY 2004–2005,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.saffm.hq.af.mil/shared/media/document/AFD-070223-048.pdf |title=USAF Committee Staff Procurement Backup Book FY 2004/2005 Biennial Budget Estimates |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071015215959/http://www.saffm.hq.af.mil/shared/media/document/AFD-070223-048.pdf |archive-date=2007-10-15 |page=187 (Missile Procurement, Air Force, Budget Activity 05, Other Support, Item No. 18) |access-date=2009-04-29}}</ref> this cryptographic algorithm is used for [[Global Positioning System]]s (GPS), [[Space-Based Infrared System]]s (SBIRS), [[Military Satellite Communications Systems Wing|MILSATCOM]], and other Special Project Systems.
